job.title: Electrical Commissioning Supervisor
job.description:
Location: Regional WA
Rate: $1,380 per day
Type: Contract
Duration: Initial 12 month contract
Hours: 12-hour days | 2:1 FIFO roster

We are seeking experienced Electrical Commissioning Supervisors to support the delivery of major decarbonisation and infrastructure projects across multiple operating sites in Regional WA.

This role is responsible for leading the safe and efficient commissioning and energisation of electrical systems from installation verification through to operational handover. Working closely with engineering, construction, project delivery, and operations teams, you will play a key role in ensuring systems are commissioned safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.

  • Strong experience with HV and LV electrical systems, switchgear, transformers, MCCs, protection systems, and control equipment
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing commissioning teams in FIFO environments
  • Strong understanding of electrical safety systems, compliance requirements, and commissioning processes
  • Ability to interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, and technical documentation
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • HV Switching Ticket
  • Previous iron ore project experience

  • $1,380 per day

job.title: Fixed Plant Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Fixed Plant Mechanical Technician to join a major mining and industrial operation in the Pilbara.

The Role

You will carry out preventative and corrective maintenance, hydraulic repairs and mechanical fault-finding across a range of fixed plant equipment.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Carrying out scheduled preventative and corrective maintenance on fixed plant equipment.
  • Diagnosing and repairing hydraulic systems, including pumps, motors, cylinders, valves and power units.
  • Maintaining and repairing pumps, gearboxes, vibrating screens, screw conveyors and associated equipment.
  • Assisting with mechanical inspections and repairs on gas systems under supervision.
  • Responding to breakdowns and troubleshooting mechanical faults to minimise downtime.
  • Reading and interpreting hydraulic schematics and technical drawings.
  • Completing maintenance records and work orders using a maintenance management system.
  • Working closely with Operations, Electrical and Engineering teams.
  • Maintaining high safety standards and following site procedures, isolations and permit-to-work requirements.
Skills and Experience
  • Certificate III in Engineering – Mechanical Trade or equivalent.
  • Proven fixed plant maintenance experience in mining, processing or heavy industrial environments.
  • Strong hydraulic fault-finding and repair skills.
  • Ability to interpret hydraulic schematics and technical drawings.
  • Experience with preventative maintenance and breakdown response.
  • Current Australian driver's licence.
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment medical and complete required site inductions.
Desirable
  • Working at Heights and Confined Space tickets.
  • High Risk Work Licence, forklift or EWP licence.
  • Dogging or rigging experience.
  • Experience with maintenance management systems.

Senior Environmental Advisor

Perth CBD | Monday-Friday (5:2 Roster) | 12-Month Initial Contract
Our client, a leading Tier 1 mining organisation, is seeking an experienced Senior Environmental Advisor to join their Approvals team in Perth. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in the environmental approvals and impact assessment process for major resource, infrastructure, and mining projects across Western Australia.
Working within a high-performing environmental approvals team, you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex projects by providing environmental approvals expertise, managing regulatory processes, and ensuring projects progress efficiently through State and Commonwealth approval pathways.

The Role as a Senior Environmental Advisor, you will be responsible for:
  • Managing and progressing environmental approvals for major mining and infrastructure projects.
  • Conducting environmental impact assessments and supporting project development activities.
  • Preparing and coordinating State and Federal environmental approval applications, including Part IV and EPBC referrals.
  • Providing strategic environmental approvals advice to project and operational stakeholders.
  • Managing environmental studies, consultants, and specialist contractors.
  • Liaising with internal project teams to communicate approvals requirements and obligations.
  • Supporting regulatory engagement activities and approvals planning.
  • Undertaking site visits as required.

  • Demonstrated experience working within the resources, mining, infrastructure, or government sectors.
  • Strong knowledge of State and Federal environmental legislation and approval processes.
  • Experience contributing to or managing environmental approval applications and associated studies.
  • Well-developed report writing, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills.
  • Strong proficiency across Microsoft Office applications.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Highly Regarded
  • Experience with Part IV Environmental Protection Act approvals.
  • Knowledge of EPBC Act approval processes.
  • GIS software experience.
  • Understanding of the Western Australian mining sector and Pilbara environmental landscape.

  • Perth CBD location.

  • Exposure to a highly regarded approvals team within a Tier 1 mining environment.
